note: Level table shared by client and server (GAME-LOOPS P0-1). requiredXp follows levelFor in server/domain.mjs: 100*(level-1)^2. Every level unlocks one thing to do or wear; staker lures are gated by tier only (owner decision 1 Nov) and are not part of this table; nothing here ever changes odds, damage, GOLD or payouts. Numbers in `value` are defaults: the operator can override any entry with LEVEL_TABLE_FILE. `item` entries are the level-only Aura editions (claim prefix earned:level:, approved by the owner 1 Nov); they stay hidden and unclaimable unless LEVEL_ITEM_EDITIONS=1, which needs the collectibles upgrade that adds them first. `status`: live = works today, coming = shown as a preview until its feature ships.
